title: An Octopus Has Three Hearts, and the Main One Stops When It Swims

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts, and swimming makes the biggest one stop.
Two small hearts push blood through the gills. The third, the big one, feeds the rest of the body.
When the octopus jets through the water, that main heart stops beating for a few moments.
Researchers think the pressure of swimming makes pumping against it not worth it.
That may be why octopuses tire fast when swimming, and prefer to crawl along the seafloor.
Three hearts, and swimming still wears it out.

description:
An octopus has three hearts, and swimming makes the biggest one stop.
That may be why it would rather crawl than swim.
Would you trade a heart for a tentacle?
